{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Keep only the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check the range of biomarker_baseline values
print("Min and max of biomarker_baseline:", df_dedup['biomarker_baseline'].min(), df_dedup['biomarker_baseline'].max())

# Check the distribution of values
print("Distribution of biomarker_baseline:")
df_dedup['biomarker_baseline'].describe()"}
